description: Returns the full crop calendar entry: planting windows, days to harvest, zone range, sowing/transplant guidance, climate modifiers, and citation. Look up by slug, common name, or scientific name. Match is case-insensitive. Returns an error when the calendar has no entry for the query.

slug_or_name.description: Crop calendar slug ('tomato', 'pepper-sweet'), common name ('Tomato'), or scientific name ('Solanum lycopersicum'). Match is case-insensitive.

name: get_crop_details
title: Detailed Crop Profile from the CropGraph Calendar
